questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 11 Question 1: According to Gauss's Law, what is the total electric flux passing through a closed Gaussian surface enclosing net charge Q_enclosed in vacuum?
questions.solution: Gauss's law states that total electric flux through any closed surface is proportional to enclosed charge: oint E . dA = Q_enclosed / epsilon_0.
